name: How can I prevent toilet clogs in my home?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent toilet clogs in my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing toilet clogs involves mindful usage habits. Only flush human waste and toilet paper; avoid flushing 'flushable' wipes, paper towels, feminine hygiene products, dental floss, or any foreign objects. Consider using less toilet paper per flush and ensure your toilet has sufficient flushing power. Regular maintenance, such as occasional drain cleaning for slow-draining toilets, can also help. At CG Plumbing Solutions, we often see issues from non-biodegradable items, emphasizing the importance of a 'toilet-only' flushing rule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent clogs by only flushing human waste and toilet paper, avoiding non-biodegradable items, and considering regular drain maintenance.
